verdict.rationale: Plaid's blog explicitly claims a 'verify once, verify everywhere' experience allowing reuse of a prior verification, but the evidence pack has no technical documentation (API fields, session reuse endpoints, or dashboard features) showing how a developer would actually implement recognition/reuse across sessions or products — the only mechanisms documented are retry (/identity_verification/retry) and dashboard override of failed checks, which are re-verification aids, not reuse-of-passed-check flows. missing for 10: API/webhook documentation describing how a passed verification is looked up/reused, concrete integration guide for cross-product reuse, and independent confirmation this feature works as advertised.
